utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Registrar, kindly call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-74-T, the Prosecutor versus Prlic et al. Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Registrar. Today is Wednesday. My greetings to all the people in the courtroom, the Prosecution team, the Defence teams, and the accused, and my best wishes to Mr. Pusic, who is absent again today. We are going to proceed with our work, but I believe somebody wants to say something. We're going to move to private session.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President, good morning, Your Honours. Good morning everyone in and around the court. I just have one brief matter --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
